name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
summary: Single-line floating label. Built on Radix Tooltip with .lumen-glass-strong surface. 11px font-medium tracked-tight. Default delayDuration=0 for instant-on (operator density); override per-instance for longer delays in marketing surfaces.
description: Token-driven single-line tooltip with glass-strong surface.
skillDescription: Use for single-line label content tied to a trigger (icon tooltips, abbreviation expansions, keyboard shortcut hints). For multi-line / rich content use @lumen/popover or @lumen/hover-card. Default delayDuration=0 for operator density.
useWhen: Keyboard shortcut hints next to actions.
anatomy: TooltipProvider — required at app root (or per-instance)
TooltipContent — the floating label, portaled, glass-strong
api: `delayDuration` — default 0 (operator density). Pass 700 for marketing-style hover delays.
Composed inside TooltipProvider; single Tooltip auto-provides one for convenience.
never: NEVER use Tooltip for essential information — content must be auxiliary (keyboard users see it on focus).
NEVER make Tooltip multi-line — use Popover or HoverCard for rich content.
NEVER override glass-strong with a solid surface that defeats the brand glass voice.
a11yRules: Radix manages role=tooltip + aria-describedby + show on focus / hover / pointer-enter; hide on blur / escape.
Mobile / touch: tooltip surfaces via long-press; not a substitute for visible label.
do: Pair with IconButton for icon-only affordances.
dont: Don't put essential information in a tooltip.
